dedupe_keys.name: okobaudat german life cycle assessment database for building materials and processes

description: ÖKOBAUDAT is the platform of the German Federal Ministry for Housing, Urban Development and Building that gives a harmonised database for life cycle assessment of buildings, centred on an online database of LCA datasets for building materials and for construction, transport, energy and end-of-life processes. It is the mandatory data basis for the federal Assessment System for Sustainable Building (BNB), provides generic datasets based on the Sphera MLC background database and company or association datasets from environmental product declarations conforming to EN 15804, and is offered in versions for EN 15804+A2 (Sphera MLC), EN 15804+A1 (Sphera MLC) and EN 15804+A2 (ecoinvent). With tools such as the BBSR eLCA tool the whole life cycle of a building can be assembled; ÖKOBAUDAT is not to be used for product LCAs. Coverage: construction products and processes used in Germany. Access: free online search and filtering of datasets. Licence: free access, with each dataset owner responsible for content. Caveats: generic data rest on commercial background databases, and only Sphera-based sets are currently intended for BNB calculations. Simulation uses are embodied carbon and whole-building LCA of new construction and retrofit scenarios. Related records: INIES, EC3 and the ICE database.
